author: Jason Stys
summary: Evaluate owner-authored continuity requirements at policy and exception boundaries with a hash-bound review queue.
rationale: Shows upcoming access changes without granting access, renewing exceptions or assuming transitive trust.
limitations: The review previews declared transport access; it does not establish live identity/posture, sessions or service health.
Continuity requirements are assertions, not policy grants or automatic exception renewal.
Native enforcement examples operate in isolated lab namespaces, not an automatically deployed production firewall, cloud or device boundary.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
